lots.title: Measured Term Contract – Provision of Minor Disability Adaptations (minor building works)
lots.description: Provision of minor disability adaptations (under £1,000 per order) to residential properties within the London Borough of Bexley under a JCT Measured Term Contract 2024. Four-year fixed term running 1 November 2026 to 31 October 2030 with no extension option. Works are instructed via electronic orders from the Contract Administrator and prioritised across four response bands from Standard through to Hospital Discharge. Contractor acts as Principal Contractor where required and must hold SSIP-accredited H&S certification (e.g. CHAS).
requirements: Works executed under the JCT Measured Term Contract 2024 including Conditions, Contract Particulars, Schedule of Rates / Pricing Schedule and Contract Specification.
Fixed 4-year initial term 1 November 2026 – 31 October 2030 with no extension option.
All works to residential properties located within the London Borough of Bexley.

No works to commence until a valid electronic Order has been issued by the Contract Administrator, specifying description of works, priority category, property location and cost allowance where applicable.

Priority response times: Standard (D) complete within 15 working days; Urgent (C) respond same or next day, complete within 5 working days; Emergency (B) immediate response, complete within 48 hours; Hospital Discharge (A) immediate response, complete within 24 hours.

Payments made under the Housing Grants, Construction and Regeneration Act 1996 and Section 4 of the JCT Measured Term Contract 2024: monthly applications, electronic invoices, final date for payment 30 days, VAT at prevailing rate, invoices submitted within 6 months of order issue.

Statutory compliance including Building Regulations 2010, Building Safety Act 2022, CDM Regulations 2015, Gas Safety (Installation and Use) Regulations, IET Wiring Regulations BS 7671, Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order, Environmental Protection Act and Data Protection legislation.
Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974 and CDM 2015 duties; Principal Contractor role where required; SSIP accredited H&S certification (e.g. CHAS) maintained.
All staff must hold relevant trade qualifications, valid CSCS cards, carry photographic identification and hold enhanced DBS clearance where required.
Waste disposal under the Environmental Protection Act 1990; Contractor must be a registered waste carrier and provide waste transfer documentation upon request.
Contract documents include: JCT MTC 2024 Conditions, Contract Particulars, Contract Specification, Schedule of Rates / Pricing Schedule, Property Schedule and any further referenced documents.
